# MatchLab Club

> MatchLab Club is an AI-powered companion for your dating life. It audits dating profiles, rewrites bios, coaches messages, tracks communication patterns, and matches members with compatible people nearby. The single promise: become genuinely relationship-ready, then get matched with people you would never find on your own.

## What this site is

MatchLab Club sits alongside apps like Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble. It reads what a person's profile and messages are actually communicating, surfaces blind spots, and helps them improve before introducing matching. Matching is radius-based, AI-driven, and reserved for members who have built enough signal. Inclusivity is core: all genders and orientations are welcome.

## Canonical domain

https://matchlab.club

- https://matchlab.club/waitlist — early-access waitlist with listener perks
- https://matchlab.club/sample-report — example profile audit report (no sign-in required)
- https://matchlab.club/signal-check — free profile signal check tool
- https://matchlab.club/blog — editorial content on dating profiles, messaging, compatibility, and mindset
- https://matchlab.club/quizzes — self-knowledge quizzes (attachment style, conflict instinct, love pace, etc.)
- https://matchlab.club/privacy — privacy policy
- https://matchlab.club/terms — terms of service

## Pages to skip

Authenticated app pages (dashboard, coach, report, mirror, echo, matching, settings, account, vault, progress, copilot, etc.) require a sign-in and are not useful to crawl.
